final_answer:
Added `RuntimePolicy.with_instruction()` using `dataclasses.replace`, returning a new copy with validation enforced.

Only `runtime_policy.py` changed; no new fields, `enabled` attribute, or untracked files.

arguments.command:
@'
import sys
from dataclasses import fields
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
sys.path.insert(0, r'token-master-plugin\skills\token-master')
from brainspace.runtime_policy import RuntimePolicy
from brainspace.request_policy import RequestPolicy
original = RuntimePolicy()
updated = original.with_instruction('ponytail')
assert updated is not original and updated.instruction == 'ponytail'
assert original.instruction == 'none'
assert all(getattr(original, f.name) == getattr(updated, f.name) for f in fields(original) if f.name != 'instruction')
assert updated.with_instruction('none') == original
assert original.with_instruction('none') is not original
assert not hasattr(updated, 'enabled')
for policy, instruction, message in (
    (original, 'invalid', 'invalid_runtime_policy_selection'),
    (RuntimePolicy(instruction='ponytail', require_nonexpanding_input=True), 'none', 'inactive_composition_guard'),
    (RuntimePolicy(backend='local', request_policy=RequestPolicy(version='request-policy-v6', enabled=True), require_nonexpanding_input=True), 'ponytail', 'v6_rejects_instruction_guidance'),
):
    try:
        policy.with_instruction(instruction)
    except ValueError as exc:
        assert str(exc) == message
    else:
        raise AssertionError('Expected validation failure')
print('Focused checks passed')
'@ | python -B -
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
git --no-pager diff --check && git --no-pager diff --stat && git --no-pager status --short
